notes.title: The Beast Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]DRILL RIFT UPDATE – THE BEAST RISES[/b]
[i]A unique new encounter, UI improvements, and more![/i][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]First off, a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo and sent us feedback. Your thoughts have been incredibly helpful, and we’ve already put some of them into action.[/p][p]This update brings one of the biggest additions yet: [b]THE BEAST[/b] — a unique, punishing encounter that will test your planning and your dwarves’ sanity. Prepare to gain madness and face down a monster unlike anything else in the rift.[/p][p]We’ve also reworked the [b]Shipments UI[/b], making it clearer and more noticeable, plus added warning systems so you’ll always know when a shipment is on the way.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702728/6e9e5796e1b35287a4ae32d5a59b20007b2f6765.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔨 Currently in the Works[/h3][list][*][p][b]Click-to-skip dice rolls[/b] for smoother pacing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial improvements[/b] to help new players get started.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balancing adjustments[/b] to accommodate the new monster encounter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound settings rework[/b] so you can adjust button volume specifically.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📌 Planned Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Items[/b] — new tools and resources to change how you approach the rift.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization[/b] — bringing Drill Rift to more languages worldwide.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all your support — and keep that feedback coming. Every suggestion helps shape Drill Rift into the best game it can be.[/p][p][b]ROCK AND STONE![/b][/p]
